item.title: Better text editor
item.description: 📑 We've overhauled Fabric's text editor for a much better writing experience: Ability to apply style to multiple blocks Formatting UI no longer fights against mobile OS UI We built a new sync engine, with better performance and reliability across all internet connections We laid the foundations for offline mode :)

item.title: New! Readwise connection
item.description: 📖 Your Fabric now has a Readwise connector: Syncs all your existing Readwise highlights Each time you make a new highlight or annotations, it'll automatically be added to your Fabric! Save extracts and snippets that inspire you. (Note: the original source/book doesn't get brought into Fabric)

item.title: New! RSS feed support
item.description: 📣 Your Fabric now has RSS support! Subscribe to an RSS feed, and every new post will be automatically added to your Fabric. Stay up to date on the content you care about… automatically! We hope you enjoy it :)
